capabilities: Sync a vault with Nutstore over WebDAV on desktop and mobile
Choose between five sync policies (two-way, send-only, receive-only, and mirror variants)
Resolve two-way sync conflicts via conflict-free merge, diff3, or priority rules
Filter synced files with Gitignore-style include/exclude rules, size limits, and config-directory options
Chat with an AI agent that edits files, uses Skills, connects to MCP servers, and remembers preferences
disambiguation: Not only a sync tool; it also bundles an AI agent chatbox with tools, Skills, MCP connections, memory, and subagents.
extras: README warns that mirror policies can delete files unique to one side and advises backing up before the first sync; it notes the plugin is not the official Obsidian Sync service and directs issue reporting to GitHub Issues. AI agent has a YOLO (Full Access) mode that skips per-operation confirmation.
problem: Obsidian's official Sync service does not work with Nutstore, so Nutstore users lack a controlled way to sync their vault across devices.

relations.evidence: Nutstore Sync is an Obsidian plugin for syncing a vault with Nutstore on desktop and mobile
MCP: Connect configured MCP servers to bring external tools and information sources into a conversation
Use OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, or custom compatible endpoints
This plugin is not the official Obsidian Sync service

requires.name: AI provider API key (or Nutstore AI authorization)

summary: WebDAV-based sync plugin that keeps a vault in sync with Nutstore (坚果云) using configurable sync policies, with an optional built-in AI assistant.
